notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

Here is the Month Update Comming for 30/11/2023

[b][h2]Improvements[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504236/895bc9d3a1e319d864728abfe1f7fc89c49cb898.png[/img]
- Huge Improvement in the Alchemy Table
          - Now to Brew Alchemy Potions and Elixir, the player needs to drag and drop the items in the caldron (Limit of 3), if Succeseful the item will Spawn in the alchemy table, if Unsuccessful the caldron will explode and the player will be damaged.
          - The alchemy table has now a save system, so if you want to store items that you deem necessary you can drop in the alchemy table and they will be stored.
          - The Save System has a location and location, so Organize your alchemy table as you wish, the table is shared by all players in the session.

- All items now have Visual Meshes
- Chest have less chance to appear
- Puddles gives less wet and players get dry faster
- Impeficus (Final Boss) now has a Fight Count ( 3 Max ) (For the Lore)
- Impeficus Room now has a door wall
- Items now have a bump sound (Next Update will be improved)
- Impact Frames with Advaced Spells

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504236/dac0d930dad325fb9a6ce46ecd91a74877536db5.png[/img]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]

- Coin Drop in the ground and disapear
- Merlin Lore now in english
-  Water Puddle now drop to the ground insted of floating
- Wet Sound Descreased
- In multiplayer bosses spawn twice, now only spawn once per session
- After Using Beam Spell cant do other spells
- Bolder Drop Disapear
- Item Focus Blur
- Amulet of Water in description was saiyng "Ring" insted of "Amulet"

[b][h2]Future Improvements[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42504236/af61ef318a9c4c4f53daf30db4405bbca994067f.png[/img]

- New Desert Boss
- New Desert Monster
- More Wands / Amulets / Rings
- Voip Option "Always On"
- Better Enemy AI
- More Spells
- Visual Improvements

notes.title: Update 1.2.4
notes.content:
Hello.
This is a weekly game update, I'll try to update every week on what I'm doing to keep everyone interested in the loop.

This does not mean that I will post here every week, because the updates may be small or for other reasons.
Note that I'm currently working on the game myself and most of the assets I buy or make, so don't expect too many updates during the month as I also work part time.

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]

- Enemies Sound Bug
- Unbrekable Pots
- Bleed Properties Bug
- Skeleton Boss Sound Bug
- Widget Bugs
- Menu in game Bug

[b][h2]Improvements[/h2][/b]

- New Boss
- New Boss Art
- New Enemies
- Spawners (Rabbits)
- Desert Biome Part 1
- New Vendor
- New Items
            - Power Items
            - Power Dash Items
            - Propertie Items
- Fire Ball Spell New Mechanic
- Skill Tree Improvement
- New Chests
- New Bleed/Regen Properties
- Eat Items Mechanic (Can be good or bad)
- Hidden Rooms
- HUD Improvement
- New Power Dashes
- Lore Update


That's all for now, I work every day and will try to post what I've been working on every week.

As the game is still relatively small and there are around 2500 people interested for now, I will try to answer any questions that come up.
Aside from Lore, I don't mind talking about the future of the game/Objectives/development and mechanics, I'm an open book.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/HecThoors/media
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/user/Phraygames

Good week to everyone.
